title.default: A focused forum for international higher education.

text.default: CEEDUCON connects people who work on internationalisation every day: university leadership, international offices, policymakers, national agencies and practitioners from across Europe.

secondText.default: The programme is built around practical exchange: what is changing, what works in institutions, and where Central European cooperation can move higher education forward.
